+import jwt
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta
+
+SECRET = "demo-only"
+
def create_session_token(user_id: str) -> str:
+    payload = {"sub": user_id, "exp": datetime.utcnow() + timedelta(hours=1)}
+    return jwt.encode(payload, SECRET, algorithm="HS256")
+
def validate_session_token(token: str) -> dict:
+    return jwt.decode(token, SECRET, algorithms=["HS256"])

@@ -0,0 +1,55 @@
+def process_payment(amount: float, method: str, user_id: str) -> dict:
+    if amount <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("invalid amount")
+    if method not in {"card", "wallet"}:
+        raise ValueError("unsupported method")
+    if user_id is None:
+        raise ValueError("missing user")
+    status = "pending"
+    if amount > 1000:
+        status = "review"
+    elif amount > 100:
+        if method == "card":
+            status = "authorized"
+        else:
+            status = "queued"
+    else:
+        status = "captured"
+    if status == "review":
+        if method == "wallet":
+            return {"status": status, "manual": True}
+        return {"status": status, "manual": False}
+    return {"status": status, "amount": amount}
